requiredTrustSeparation: untrusted project execution cannot access Docker socket or raw API
trusted operation source pinned, reviewed and not writable by project/job configurator
distinct OS execution identity and protected operation interface; separate job name insufficient
do not forward production credentials or environment
require independently authenticated authorizations, no arbitrary shell/argv
storagePrerequisites: verified all-domain hard quotas or equivalent bounds
guest and Mac physical COW headroom independently proven
tmpfs only bounded small scratch not full DB by default
reports/logs/archives bounded before materializing on disk

cleanupContract.transportFailure: Do not assume create/stop failed atomically. Creation timeout may have created an unknown-ID container; block new runs and success. Do not retry create blindly.
cleanupContract.daemonUnavailable: No cleanup attestation; UNCERTAIN_BLOCKED. Container may remain alive even with live-restore=false on unexpected failure. No host PID kill fallback.
cleanupContract.reconnect: Verify same daemon ID and ledger; list is candidate discovery only. Exact container ID+nonce+Created+owner+image+mount match required. Name/label alone never deletion authorization.
cleanupContract.stopRemove: Only verified owned ID: bounded stop then owned-ID kill if needed; confirm exited and cgroup empty/absent, remove and verify not-found; never prune.
cleanupContract.noIDAfterCreateTimeout: Matching intent nonce candidates require full ownership proof; mismatches/multiple candidates/operator approval -> remain blocked; never broad deletion.
cleanupContract.manualEscalation: daemon remains unreachable beyond bounded retry window, daemon identity changed, foreign mount, ambiguous ownership, missing ledger, cgroup unknown or cleanup incomplete; operator receives metadata only, no production mutations.
cleanupContract.ttlWarning: client watchdog/labels do not stop a container when daemon API is unreachable; do not claim enforced TTL without independent proven mechanism

rollbackDesign: revoke only newly introduced future executor capability
retain ownership ledger and receipts until cleanup verified
never restore unrestricted socket as rollback shortcut
production job/socket/daemon changes require separate approved change plan
